name: Haircut Valuation
definition: Basic valuation details of an asset's market value.

Haircut.name: Haircut
Haircut.definition: Haircut or valuation factor on the security expressed as a percentage.

Sign.name: Sign
Sign.definition: One of the following PlusOrMinusIndicator values must be used:|MeaningWhenTrue: Plus (the haircut is added)|MeaningWhenFalse: Minus (the haircut is deducted)

AssetHolding.name: Asset Holding
AssetHolding.definition: Asset holding for which a haircut is specified.

PartyRole.name: Party Role
PartyRole.definition: Specifies the role of a party in the haircut valuation process.
